name: PHARMACEUTICAL GMP STERILIZER
desc: Fully Automatic PLC-Controlled Pharmaceutical GMP Pulse Vacuum Sterilizer engineered for high-stringency sterilization workflows. Features a 600-liter horizontal chamber fabricated from premium SS316L, driven by a heavy-duty water ring vacuum pump for deep vacuum cycles.
features: 600 Litre flagship industrial high-capacity sterilization envelope
Fully automated deep Pre-Vacuum extraction and final Post-Vacuum drying phases
Motor-driven pneumatic sliding type door configuration
High-resolution interactive industrial color touchscreen HMI controller dashboard

specifications.Equipment Configuration: High-Performance Industrial Pharmaceutical GMP Pulse Vacuum Sterilizer
specifications.Chassis Structural Shape: Heavy-duty large horizontal autoclave layout with deep vacuum integration
specifications.Volumetric Processing Capacity: 600 Litre flagship industrial high-capacity sterilization envelope
specifications.Chamber Internal Dimensions: Spacious cleanroom inner processing size measuring 680 × 850 × 1050 mm
specifications.Sterilization Door Material: High-durability matching polished Stainless Steel 316L heavy structural layout
